title: Inkokeli Emiselweyo Yesizwe
intro: Ngexesha lomngeni omkhulu nokuphelelwa lithemba kubantu, kwenziwa isigqibo sikaThixo. Lo mntu, ekuqaleni engajongwanga ngabaninzi, wakhethwa nguAllah ukuba akhokele uhlanga nxamnye notshaba olunamandla. Ibali labo lingqina lamandla okholo kunye nobulumko obusemva komyalelo kaThixo, obonisa ukuba ubunkokeli bokwenyani abusoloko bufumaneka kwiindawo ezilindelweyo.
clues: Ndakhethwa nguAllah ukuba ndibe yinkokeli yabantu bam xa babefuna umlawuli wokulwa ngenxa yaKhe.
Ekuqaleni abantu bam babengabaza ukumiselwa kwam, bevakalelwa kukuba abanye bafaneleka ngakumbi ngenxa yobutyebi babo okanye umnombo wabo.
Uphawu lobunkokeli bam obufanelekileyo yayikukubuya kwebhokisi engcwele, equlethe izinto ezifunyenwe kubaprofeti bangaphambili, nto leyo eyazisa uxolo.
Ndakhokela umkhosi wam ndaya emlanjeni, apho ndavavanya ukuthobela kwabo ngokubalela ukuba basele amanzi angaphezu kwekhaphu enye.
Nangona inani elincinci labo bahlala beqinile emva kovavanyo, sijongene nomloli onamandla kunye nomkhosi wakhe.
Phantsi kolawulo lwam, umntu oselula ovela kumkhosi wam, owayengengomloli odumileyo, wajongana waza woyisa iqhawe lotshaba elinamandla ngesibindi.

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Intshatsheli yotshaba yoyiswa, waza uAllah wamnika uloyiso.
outcome.answer: Intshatsheli yotshaba yoyiswa, waza uAllah wamnika uloyiso.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
